meta.name: imaging-data-commons
meta.description: Query and download public cancer imaging data from NCI Imaging Data Commons using idc-index. Use for accessing large-scale radiology (CT, MR, PET) and pathology datasets for AI training or research. No authentication required. Query by metadata, visualize in browser, check licenses.

copy.tagline: 查询和下载公共癌症影像数据用于研究
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要获取大规模癌症影像数据集用于AI训练或学术研究
copy.tagline_en: Query and download public cancer imaging data for research
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to access large-scale cancer imaging datasets for AI training or academic research

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能查询、下载 NCI Imaging Data Commons 中的公开癌症影像数据（CT、MR、PET、病理切片），无需认证。可按元数据筛选、在浏览器中可视化、检查许可。
howto.when: 当用户需要获取或分析公开的癌症影像数据时，例如查找特定癌症类型的 CT 图像或下载 DICOM 数据集。

say.text: 查找 IDC 中所有肺癌 CT 数据集。
下载 SeriesInstanceUID 为 xxx 的 DICOM 文件。
可视化这个系列的影像：xxx。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can query and download public cancer imaging data (CT, MR, PET, pathology) from NCI Imaging Data Commons without authentication. It can filter by metadata, visualize in browser, and check licenses.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user needs to access or analyze public cancer imaging data, e.g., finding CT images for a specific cancer type or downloading DICOM datasets.

say_en.text: Find all lung CT datasets in IDC.
say_en.note: Claude will query collection id tcga_luad.

say_en.text: Download DICOM files for SeriesInstanceUID xxx.
say_en.note: A specific UID must be provided.
A viewer URL will be generated.
